steps.zh: 安装独立的 uv 二进制

steps.en: Create a project and declare its dependencies
steps.code: uv init example · uv add ruff

steps.en: Resolves all dependencies and writes one cross-platform lockfile
steps.zh: 解析全部依赖，写出一份跨平台锁文件

steps.en: Creates .venv, fetching a Python build if needed, and links packages from its global cache
steps.zh: 建好 .venv，缺 Python 就下载，从全局缓存链接包

steps.en: Run commands through uv instead of activating the environment
steps.zh: 通过 uv 运行命令，不用手动激活环境

steps.en: Before each run, re-syncs the lockfile and environment with pyproject.toml
steps.zh: 每次运行前，按 pyproject.toml 同步锁文件和环境

value.en: One tool and one lockfile reproduce the same environment on every laptop and CI runner, in seconds
value.zh: 一个工具、一份锁文件，在每台笔记本和 CI 上几秒内还原出同一个环境

sources: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv#projects (uv init example, uv add ruff, uv run ruff check, uv lock, uv sync)
https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/blob/main/docs/concepts/projects/run.md (uv run ensures the project environment is up-to-date before running)
